name: minio
description: MinIO (S3-compatible object storage, single-node/SNSD): backs up the data directory 'minio-data' directly at the file level including the internal metadata (.minio.sys: format.json, IAM/bucket/versioning config) and excludes only the transient directories .minio.sys/tmp and .minio.sys/multipart (only in-progress, unfinished uploads). No DB auto-detection (no SQL DB), no shell hooks. CONSISTENCY: A live backup is usually sufficient for a lightly used instance, but is NOT guaranteed to be crash-consistent (SNSD writes xl.meta partly in place and has no parity for self-healing); for strict consistency, briefly stop the MinIO container for the snapshot. RESTORE: requires the same MINIO_ROOT_USER/MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD and - if set - the same MINIO_KMS_SECRET_KEY (lives in the compose env, NOT in minio-data; otherwise IAM is in plaintext in .minio.sys/config). Different volume name? Adjust the exclude prefix 'minio-data'.
